shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry carved figurative imagery including a profile quadruped, but that is essentially the only overlap: A shows a single isolated animal in relief on an upright slab, with no scene or companions, while B is a crowded panel of many small schematic signs dominated by repeated boats with rows of crew-strokes, footprint/hand shapes and human figures. The relationships, density and repertoire are entirely different, and the rendering conventions (a single smooth naturalistic relief animal versus tiny linear pecked pictographs) do not correspond.
